remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks notes backing inscriptions and indicates, "Note: O'Keeffe says it is the same year as the other apple families." Stretcher inscription 1 dates 1921 and indicates no. 33 in 1923 New York (Anderson) exhibition. Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1921. Dated 1921 on basis of stretcher inscription. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 15. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
